newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian foreign minister to visit Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Croatian foreign minister to visit Moscow.

text.p: Croatian Foreign Minister Mate Granic said on Monday he would visit Russia for talks following Zagreb's normalisation of relations with the rump Yugoslavia.

"The main subject of our talks will certainly be the situation in the wider region after signing the agreement on normalisation of relations, and European stability in general," Granic told HTV state television.
HTV did not say when he would go to Moscow but indicated he would depart soon for the visit, which would include talks with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov.
Croatia and Yugoslavia, which fought a war when Zagreb declared independence five years ago, recognised each other on August 23 and established diplomatic relations on September 9.
